title: uncaria callophylla var. oligoneura
intro: Uncaria callophylla var. oligoneura, commonly known as a variant of the Uncaria plant species, is a type of flowering plant in the Rubiaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Uncaria callophylla var. oligoneura are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
